labels.text: Section 2032A(a)(2)-(3): the aggregate limitation on the section 2032A(a)(1) reduction in fair market value. Only the statutorily EXACT, not-yet-inflation-adjusted $750,000 figure (in effect for estates of decedents dying in calendar year 1998, before the section 2032A(a)(3) cost-of-living adjustment first applies) is pinned here. Every later year's adjusted figure (published administratively — historically as a Rev. Proc./news-release table, not a figure this task's SOURCE-MANIFEST.json pins) is a gap: evaluation returns MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE rather than a fabricated indexed amount. See TECH-GAPS.md G478.

section 2032A(a)(2): 'shall not exceed $750,000', for a decedent dying in calendar year 1998 itself (section 2032A(a)(3) only increases this amount for a decedent dying in a calendar year AFTER 1998, mirroring the section 2010(c)(3) basic-exclusion-amount pattern already used in basic-exclusion-amount.lawparam.json)
